# Compatibility matrix

Classification status: **preliminary, unverified against Free Edition limits**.

## Classes

- `native`: Runs on Databricks Free Edition serverless with little or no change.
- `adapted`: Needs changes such as volume paths instead of local or DBFS paths, a file or rate source instead of Kafka, or removing RDD, sparkContext, cache or spark.master settings.
- `alt_env`: Needs an environment outside the Free Edition browser workspace, such as a Kafka broker, Databricks CLI, VS Code, CI/CD or an external Git provider.

| Class | Count |
| --- | --- |
| native | 1 |
| adapted | 56 |
| alt_env | 6 |
| total | 63 |

## Free Edition constraints (own summary)

Source: [Databricks Free Edition limitations](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/getting-started/free-edition-limitations), retrieved 2026-11-27.

- Serverless compute only; custom compute configurations are not supported.
- Outbound internet access is limited to a set of trusted domains.
- One SQL warehouse (2X-Small), max 5 concurrent job tasks, one active pipeline per pipeline type.
- R and Scala are not supported; custom workspace storage locations are not supported.
- One workspace and one metastore per account; no account console or account-level APIs; no SSO or SCIM.
- Usage quotas apply; exceeding them shuts compute down for the rest of the day.
- Non-commercial use only; no SLA or support.
